extracted.intended_audience: researchers, industry and academic groups seeking ONR funding or partnership
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for aligning research proposals and partnerships with the Office of Naval Research (ONR): emphasis on investments that increase fundamental knowledge, enable breakthroughs, and provide technology options for future naval capabilities, across a broad range of disciplines and time horizons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increase fundamental knowledge
rubrics_metrics.description: ONR makes broad investments in basic and applied research that will increase fundamental knowledge.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should contribute to expanding fundamental scientific understanding as a core objective of ONR-supported research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foster opportunities for breakthroughs
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research that creates pathways to transformative advances is prioritized; emphasize potential for major advances rather than incremental improvements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide technology options for future naval capabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide technology options for future naval capabilities and systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frame research in terms of how outcomes could translate into technology choices or options for naval systems and warfighter needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support both basic and applied research
rubrics_metrics.description: ONR makes broad investments in basic and applied research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ONR funds work across the spectrum from foundational science to applied efforts; proposals may be long-term/basic or targeted/applied depending on the program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor research across critical scientific disciplines
rubrics_metrics.description: ONR-sponsored research covers a broad spectrum of science and engineering disciplines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interdisciplinary and domain-specific projects across science and engineering are within scope; identify the relevant ONR technology area when proposing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partner with industry, academia, and naval centers
rubrics_metrics.description: Working with partners from industry, academia, naval warfare centers and other knowledge-based organizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collaboration with external partners is expected and encouraged; describe roles, expertise, and partnership value in proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Span time horizons from long-term to near-term
rubrics_metrics.description: Our program officers work on everything from long-term (basic) scientific research, all the way to near-term solutions and quick-reaction prototype deliveries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarify whether the work targets foundational, long-horizon research, near-term solutions, or rapid prototyping and how the effort will transition to capability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program managers as technical points of contact
rubrics_metrics.description: Program managers are the technical point of contact for ONR-sponsored research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engage program managers early as the primary technical interlocutors to ensure alignment with ONR priorities and appropriate programmatic fit.
